look_here_first: Start with the leaf base and male-flower pedicels: triangular-lanceolate to triangular-ovate serrate leaves with truncate-to-cordate bases; staminate flowers are clustered distally and their persistent pedicel bases are very short.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: perennial herb or subshrub with stinging hairs

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: persistent staminate pedicel bases about 0.3–0.6 mm

lookalikes.differences: Short persistent staminate pedicel bases and distally clustered male flowers are especially useful; T. urticifolia has longer staminate pedicels and a different distribution of staminate flowers.
